segments.text: Alright, those are some important changes I'd like you all to know.
Now, if you have any further questions, do first log on to the library website and check
the FAQs for answers before you contact our librarians.
Of course, the library staff will do their best to answer your questions, but it's better
to save us all some time, right?
If there is any problem that cannot be answered by the librarians, they will direct you to
our specialists. Jamie Moss is our buyer. He's responsible for purchasing new items
for the library. So, if you think of any items that should be on the shelves, contact him.
We cannot promise to buy everything you ask for, but your request will be taken into careful
consideration. If you encounter technical issues with the
computers during your study at the library, Alice Turner is the one you call. She's
She's our IT expert, and she can handle almost every computer problem.
She cannot deal with printers, though.
We need to call our supplier for that.
The library staff can give you access to almost every study room, except for the Bloomberg
Trading Room.
You have to meet certain requirements to gain access to that one.
But if you do, contact Jamal Saeed and follow his instructions.
The requirements can be found on our website or you can ask any of our staff.
For those of you seeking advice for writing a good CV and tips on interviews, Tina Bell
is the one to contact.
Many senior students have met her and they all found her really helpful in this particular
field.
She's working on her own book about this subject and it will soon be available on
our shelves.
Last but not least, Thomas Cook is our handyman.
He can fix almost every malfunction of the library facilities, such as unstable desks,
plumbing or electrical issues.
He has another job as a plumber, so he may be unavailable at times.
Well, that's enough for now.
If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact our staff, or even me.
